fixed.summary: The default tag halo is in contrast-color(currentColor), the text's own ink: black round pale or gold ink, white round dark or navy ink (it was --ink-inverse, the same as a light text's ink in the light scheme). currentColor inside a colour function in text-shadow is the element's colour.
A text whose element cuts a gradient to it (background-clip: text) is read in that gradient, once; it was read as white, the glyph mask og-ui draws it through.

Their inks follow the palette and the packs where they sat on a ground they did not follow: StrategyTower's cost on an affordable path is --on-primary, Ribbon's text is contrast-color() of its tone with the tag outline, Calibration's step badges take the accent and neutral tones, WorldMap's legend is a scene plate in --scene-ink.

The HUD components and screens drawn over the scene (the ability bar, minimap, compass, timers, meters, the genre HUDs, subtitles, objectives and banners) write `text-shadow: var(--tag-halo)` on their root, so every text in them takes the style's tag outline.
